queries_attempted: WhatsApp Business auto reply scheduler time based
WhatsApp Business third party scheduling tool

competitors.name: WhatsApp Business App (Native)
competitors.notes: The native WhatsApp Business app provides away messages and greeting messages but lacks any scheduling capability. Users can set a single away message with a custom schedule (e.g., 'always send' or 'custom schedule' for specific hours), but this is limited to one message and does not support multiple time/day-specific messages. No scheduling for greetings.
competitors.feature_overlap: Away messages, greeting messages, basic custom schedule (single message only)
competitors.market_positioning: Official small business tool from Meta

competitors.name: WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API / On-Premises)
competitors.notes: The WhatsApp Business API allows businesses to send messages programmatically and set up automated replies via webhooks. It does not natively provide a scheduling UI for away messages or greetings. Developers must build custom scheduling logic. Not a direct competitor for non-technical small business owners.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated replies, message sending via API

competitors.name: WATI (WhatsApp Team Inbox)
competitors.notes: WATI is a WhatsApp Business API platform that offers automated replies, chatbots, and scheduled messaging. It supports scheduling broadcast messages and automated responses, but its away message scheduling is not as granular as per-time/day customization for greetings. It is more focused on team inbox and customer support automation.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated replies, scheduled messages, chatbot, team inbox
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp Business API platform for SMBs and teams

competitors.name: Twilio WhatsApp API
competitors.notes: Twilio provides WhatsApp Business API access with full programmatic control. Developers can build custom scheduling for away messages and greetings. Not a direct solution for non-technical users; requires development effort.

competitors.name: ManyChat
competitors.notes: ManyChat is a chatbot platform for WhatsApp (and other channels). It offers automated responses, sequences, and scheduling. However, its scheduling is primarily for marketing sequences and not specifically for away message/greeting scheduling per time/day. More focused on marketing automation than simple away message management.
competitors.pricing: Free plan available; paid plans start at $15/month

competitors.name: Chatfuel
competitors.notes: Chatfuel offers WhatsApp chatbot automation with scheduled messages and auto-replies. Similar to ManyChat, it is more marketing-oriented and does not provide a simple away message scheduler for small business owners.
competitors.pricing: Free plan available; paid plans start at $15/month
competitors.market_positioning: Chatbot platform for marketing and support

competitors.name: Zoko
competitors.notes: Zoko is a WhatsApp Business API platform that offers team inbox, automated replies, and scheduled broadcasts. It has some scheduling capabilities but is not specifically designed for away message/greeting scheduling per time/day.
competitors.feature_overlap: Automated replies, scheduled broadcasts, team inbox
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp Business API platform for sales and support

competitors.name: Interakt
competitors.notes: Interakt provides WhatsApp Business API tools including automated replies, chatbots, and scheduled messages. It offers away message automation but lacks granular per-time/day scheduling for greetings.
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp Business API platform for SMBs

competitors.name: WhatsApp Auto Reply (various apps)
competitors.notes: There are numerous third-party Android apps that claim to auto-reply to WhatsApp messages. Most are unreliable, violate WhatsApp ToS, and have poor reviews. They often lack scheduling features and are not suitable for business use.

competitors.name: Open source WhatsApp bots (e.g., whatsapp-web.js)
competitors.notes: Open source libraries like whatsapp-web.js allow developers to build custom WhatsApp bots with auto-reply and scheduling. Requires technical expertise and may violate WhatsApp ToS (non-API approach). Not a direct competitor for non-technical users.
competitors.market_positioning: Developer tool for custom WhatsApp automation

substitutes.name: Manual scheduling (calendar reminders)
substitutes.notes: Small business owners set calendar reminders to manually toggle away messages on/off or change greeting text at specific times. This is the primary workaround.

substitutes.name: Virtual assistant / VA services
substitutes.notes: Some businesses hire virtual assistants to manually update WhatsApp Business away messages and greetings on a schedule.

summary: The competitive landscape for scheduling away messages and greetings in WhatsApp Business is weak. The native WhatsApp Business app provides basic away messages with a single custom schedule (e.g., send during business hours), but does not support multiple messages per time/day or scheduled greetings. Third-party platforms like WATI, ManyChat, Chatfuel, Zoko, and Interakt offer more advanced automation but are primarily focused on chatbots, marketing sequences, or team inboxes, not on the simple use case of scheduling away messages and greetings per time/day. These platforms are also more expensive and complex than what a typical small business owner needs. There is no purpose-built, simple, affordable tool that solves exactly this problem. The main workaround is manual toggling or using calendar reminders. The opportunity is real and underserved.
